name: The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game - Definitive Edition

accessibility.description: LOTR Access speaks menus, cards, the board, story texts, objectives and reward screens through NVDA. The whole game plays with an Xbox controller or the keyboard. Function keys give help, a summary of resources, threat and phase, your hand, the current request or objective, full card details, repeat, and a read-out of the whole screen, with optional navigation sounds. The deck builder is replaced by a simple menu with card and Sauron galleries, card purchases and deck editing. Announcements are in English or French. The first launch is long and needs an internet connection. Windows only.
